Forty alien ships land on forty cities at the same hour. Their giants eat everyone who refuses to kneel. Those who kneel get a glowing red collar and fight for the invaders.

Their leader is the Maw King — a colossal troll with an old man's face, one white eye and one black eye, and a heart that heals every wound the moment it is made. "Noon tomorrow — this world kneels."

Lena, the half-wolf girl, and her father Daniel — the pilot who became a wolf — gather the last ones who will never kneel: Seo and her squad, Brandt, and the orc Revenant with his sledgehammer. The final battle begins at the Great Dam.

Lena has a plan no one would agree to: let the King swallow her, and stop his heart from the inside.
Her father has one chance to hold the King until noon — an untested serum, Nine-X. It turns him into a giant.

This full sci-fi action movie brings together an alien invasion, werewolves, a giant iron-fisted wolf against a giant troll king, an epic battle at the dam, and a daughter who goes where no one can follow.

Watch to the very end. The last words are for Lena.
